faq.a: GoSuits publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does GoSuits offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. GoSuits publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.
GoSuits publishes two offices, in Chicago and Carrollton. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at GoSuits?
faq.a: GoSuits names five attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Illinois does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

json_ld_descriptions: GoSuits Personal Injury Lawyers serve California, Texas & Illinois. Available 24/7 for accident victims. No delays, clear updates, and client-focused care always.

Sean Chalaki is the founding attorney of GoSuits, widely recognized as one of the top personal injury lawyers in Texas and California. Based in Dallas, he represents clients in catastrophic injury, construction accident, trucking accident, product liability, brain injury, premises liability, and wrongful death cases. Over 500 cases successfully litigated with a 100% win rate on litigated cases.

Yasamin Moussavi is a Principal at GoSuits, licensed to practice in Texas, New York, South Australia, and Iran. She handles compliance and civil litigation matters with experience in both Common Law and Civil Law systems, focusing primarily on personal injury litigation in Texas.

Shawn S. Hashemi is a Principal at GoSuits and Managing Attorney of the Illinois office. A dedicated civil litigator licensed in Texas and Illinois, he focuses on personal injury, insurance bad faith, construction law, business torts, and real estate litigation. Prior to law, he spent over a decade in construction project management.
Personal injury representation across California, Texas, and Illinois.
